_about: OWNER CARRIES (pipeline.regs.review.owner_carry): DFO marks held over a move the owner himself decided after making them. An entry holds only while the mark in force is the one it names (`mark`: recheck.mark_digest, `mark_date`) AND the place's binding print is the one his decision produced (`binding`: dfo.prints); any later move reads stale again. Added on the owner's word only; marks.jsonl is never edited.

decision.what: the Cowichan River water's tributaries flag off; this dormant place has no flag of its own, so it reads the water's: the whole river without side streams (720 -> 16 sections)
